value: floor_limit_diag: vector plus written proof, NOT a general Lean theorem. For 0<=c<1, p in (1/2,1), cumulative-floor quotas and S(A)=1/2, variance is order N and quota mean shift is O(1); the standard independent-array normal approximation yields error tending to 1/2. Finite vector: K=1,p=3/4,c=1/3,w=[1], N=1..12; A=0 has q=1/2, A=1 has q=5/6, target floor=1/8. The finite unbiased diagonal identity is kernel-checked; it does not establish a general limit. theta=0 belongs to this diagonal and retains mass (1-p)^K/2. c=1 is excluded: its zero conditional variance needs a separate tie-preserving allocation contract.
